**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Resolve a live Fly machine instead of pinning its ID**

When Machine `0807ee9cd34668` is replaced or removed during a future rollout, the daily monitor will fail before reading the mailbox and report only `mailbox_read_failed:RuntimeError`, even if another healthy `tdf-hq` Machine is available. The inspected release flow in `scripts/production-release.mjs` discovers the current Machine set dynamically and explicitly handles targets disappearing, so this long-lived monitor should likewise let `flyctl ssh console` select a live Machine or resolve one from `flyctl machines list` rather than embedding a deployment-specific ID.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Continue after unsupported ZIP attachments**

When any message in INBOX or Junk contains an encrypted (or otherwise unsupported) `.zip` with an XML member, `archive.open(member)` raises `RuntimeError`/`NotImplementedError`, neither of which is caught here. The exception reaches the outer mailbox handler, sets `mailboxReadSucceeded` to false, and stops scanning all subsequent messages on every daily run until that attachment leaves the 14-day window. Handle archive extraction failures at this per-message boundary so one untrusted attachment is reported as unparseable without suppressing the remaining DSN/DMARC observations.
